item.title: Keep patched: Kestra OSS: OS Command Injection
item.description:
Kestra OSS: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 1.0.45, 1.3.21

First step: Update Kestra OSS to 1.0.45 or 1.3.21 or later.

Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-49869
